content.text: Every platform account you depend on is a risk you are carrying on someone else's terms. PayPal can freeze your balance with no warning and hold it for 180 days. Stripe can reject your application because your country is on an internal risk list they will never show you. Gumroad can suspend your store because an algorithm flagged your content category. These events happen to thousands of creators every month — disproportionately in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Ethiopia, and other markets that conventional payment platforms treat as high-risk by default. The customer list is in your Supabase database or [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-actually-how|The COREMERCH]].github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-explained-digital-4|google]] Sheet. The order history is exportable as CSV at any time. The product files are in your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The wallet addresses and all funds were never touched by anyone else. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The first option, renting infrastructure from platforms like Stripe, comes with obvious trade-offs: you're at the mercy of their whims, with funds that can be frozen or withheld at any moment. But what about the alternatives? COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) offers a GitHub Pages-hosted storefront with automatic crypto payment verification, while the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) adds Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and more for a robust, scalable solution. Meanwhile, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, platforms like Stripe are notoriously opaque about their policies and procedures. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign infrastructure is built from the ground up to support creators in countries where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. With tools like NOWPayments, you can process payments in 300+ cryptocurrencies without relying on KYC or buyer accounts.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Self-custody means holding crypto in a wallet where you control the private keys — not in an exchange account, not in a payment processor's custodial system, but in a wallet where only you can authorize transactions. MetaMask, Trust Wallet, and hardware wallets like Ledger are common options for different security levels and use cases. When digital store revenue flows into a self-custody wallet, no company can freeze it, no regulator can direct a platform to hold it, and no compliance algorithm can flag it for review. COREMERCH configures NOWPayments to route all payments directly to the wallet addresses you provide during setup.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is built from the ground up to support creators in restricted countries.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The ownership structure of a COREMERCH deployment is explicit and verifiable. After any deployment, the customer holds all of the following under their own accounts: the storefront code in their GitHub or Cloudflare account, the customer email list in their Supabase database or Google Sheet, the order and payment history exportable as CSV at any time, the product files in their Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, the NOWPayments account set up under their email address, all wallet addresses and the funds inside them. COREMERCH has zero access to any of these after delivery.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The practical steps to infrastructure sovereignty start with choosing where your data lives. In Stack 01, orders are stored in Google Sheets — your Google account, your data, exportable at any time. In Stack 02, orders are stored in Supabase — your Supabase account, PostgreSQL database, full SQL access, exportable at any time. Product files in Stack 01 live in Google Drive — your Google account, 15GB free, shared via time-limited links generated by Apps Script. In Stack 02, files live in Cloudflare R2 — your Cloudflare account, 10GB free, zero egress fees, presigned URLs with configurable expiry.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The most important question a reader would ask is, 'Can I really own my store infrastructure and avoid platform suspension risks?' The answer is yes, with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, you have complete ownership and control over your store, and you can rest assured that your funds are safe from platform whims.
Traditional payment platforms like Stripe are opaque about their policies and procedures, leaving creators vulnerable to platform whims.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more information on building a sovereign digital commerce stack, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) — everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. And when you're ready to shop, head to our products page at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: deploy your storefront code on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, set up automatic crypto payment verification with NOWPayments, configure your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets, and deliver your products via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, scale your solution with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or the Complete Builder Kit ($197).
